sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Almost all actions in Escape from Tarkov grant the player experience, commonly abbreviated to XP or EXP. For example, killing, looting, or quest completions.

Seasonal change: all actions provide 25% more experience.

sections.heading: EXP modifiers
sections.text:
- Building the Hideout module "Library" grants 15% additional raid EXP.
- Using transits in the PvP game mode grants an EXP multiplier for each consecutive location.
- Owning the "Left Behind" edition of the game grants 7% additional raid EXP.
- Owning the "Prepare for Escape" edition of the game grants 9% additional raid EXP.
- Owning the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game grants 12% additional raid EXP.
- Owning the "The Unheard" edition of the game, or playing together with a player that owns it, grants 20% additional raid EXP.
